title: Bench perf smoke summary step reads bench.txt from the wrong working directory
goal: Restore the green baseline for the advisory bench-perf-smoke job: its summary step ran `cat bench.txt` from the repository root while the benchmark step wrote bench.txt inside backend/, so the job was red on every run since it landed even though the benchmarks themselves passed. Fix the working directory and add a deterministic drift guard so the writer and the reporter cannot diverge again.
statusNote: 2026-09-20: merged as PR #330 (merge commit b3350be3, 2026-09-20T05:56:27Z); branch fix/bench-perf-smoke-summary-path deleted on origin. PR checks fully green (32 success / 6 skipped, bench job included), and Bench Perf Smoke (advisory) reports success on the merge commit (run 35492933695 job 106030897699) - the missing local end-to-end replay of the bench.txt -> job summary chain is closed by that run. Residual: no gate watches advisory jobs; the second instance of that class is tracked as FR-011.
technicalDebtNote: The advisory bench job reported red for three runs (two main pushes, one PR run) without anyone noticing — the residual risk was already written into the 2026-09-20-ci-bench-perf-smoke review but the cwd defect itself was not. No gate watches advisory jobs by design; the drift guard covers the defect class, not the visibility gap.
